purpose: Define what each official property record can and cannot establish before it is used in a public legal answer.

can_support: registered title information appearing on the folio
registered burdens/interests appearing on the folio
registered proprietor information subject to the statutory framework
cannot_alone_establish: the merits of a disputed rectification application

can_support: registry-map representation associated with the registered title
cannot_alone_establish: every physical boundary on the ground
the outcome of a boundary dispute

can_support: the official search result specified by the applicable rule/form
cannot_alone_establish: facts outside the scope of the search
the legal merits of an underlying dispute

can_support: existence/location of registered deeds or conveyances within the search scope
cannot_alone_establish: the complete legal effect of a deed without examination of the instrument
current registered title where property is registered in the Land Registry

can_support: the contents of the specific instrument, subject to authentication and access conditions
cannot_alone_establish: that the instrument was legally effective in every respect
that no later instrument or registration altered the legal position

official_basis: Tailte Éireann Search and Copy Services
answer_rule: Evidence establishes only the propositions for which its content, identity, scope and legal effect have been verified.
conflict_rule: If official records conflict, expose the conflict and do not silently select a preferred record.
temporal_rule: Every record retains its retrieval date and, where relevant, the legal/historical period to which it relates.
privacy_rule: Public answers minimize personal data even when the underlying record is publicly accessible.
